hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.java) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./gradlew -q spotlessApply -PspotlessIdeHook="$f" >/dev/null ;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/web/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null ;; esac
